Pilot · United Kingdom

Alastair Atchison

British Airways Flight 53901990
Flight
British Airways Flight 5390
Date
10 June 1990
Aircraft
BAC One-Eleven
Location
Southampton
Survivors
87 of 87 aboard

With the captain pinned half outside the broken windscreen, the first officer flew the BAC One-Eleven alone to an emergency landing at Southampton. Everyone survived.

Who helped

Besides Alastair Atchison, 3 people helped on British Airways Flight 5390. What each of them did, with sources, is on Nigel Ogden's page.

  • Nigel Ogden Steward
  • John Heward Chief steward (purser)
  • Simon Rogers Steward
